mentions.speaker: Ryan Riley
mentions.quote: Right now, we're walking through Bedstuy.

mentions.speaker: Ryan Riley
mentions.quote: Then we're going to make our way to Crown Heights.

mentions.speaker: Ryan Riley
mentions.quote: Start from here and then go all the way down to Flatbush.

mentions.speaker: Ryan Riley
mentions.quote: This is Fulton Street and Nostrand. This is like the heart of Bedstuy.

mentions.speaker: Ryan Riley
mentions.quote: I think this is where I take some of my best photos. I'm not going to lie.

mentions.speaker: Ryan Riley
mentions.quote: Feels like right over here is Little Haiti... you got to have tough skin to shoot out here.

mentions.speaker: Ryan Riley
mentions.quote: Now we're headed Church Avenue, which is like one of my favorite corners. So much action, so much life.

mentions.speaker: Ryan Riley
mentions.quote: Every once in a blue, try to switch it up, like probably go to Harlem.

mentions.speaker: Ryan Riley
mentions.quote: Or probably be in the Bronx or Jamaica, Queens.

mentions.speaker: Ryan Riley
mentions.quote: It's something I've been shooting recently, like the past 2 3 years... now I make it a mission to go shoot it.

mentions.speaker: Ryan Riley
mentions.quote: This is my starting point when I come outside, especially in Crown Heights.
